pages.title: WHO declares Ebola outbreak a PHEIC

facts.text: WHO declared Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda a PHEIC; strain Bundibugyo ebolavirus; ⚠ not a pandemic emergency
facts.head: News

facts.text: Cases: 8 confirmed in Ituri Province (DRC), 246 suspected, 80 suspected deaths; 2 confirmed in Kampala (1 death)
facts.head: News

facts.text: PHEIC: highest WHO alert under International Health Regulations (IHR)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Ebola: known since 1976; largest outbreak West Africa 2014–16 (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) — 28,600+ cases, 11,325 deaths
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Viruses causing large outbreaks: Ebola, Sudan, Bundibugyo
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Incubation: 2–21 days; contact tracing 21 days
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Treatments: mAb114 (Ansuvimab), REGN-EB3 (Inmazeb); vaccines: Ervebo, Zabdeno + Mvabea (ring vaccination)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Bundibugyo strain has limited vaccine options
facts.head: Background

facts.text: 300+ cases and 88 deaths (later count); ⚠ 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo since the virus was found there in 1976
facts.head: CA360 figures

pages.title: Ecocide and international law

facts.text: Lebanon accused Israel of ecocide (2023–24 conflict); Iran alleged toxic "black rain" after strikes on fuel depots

facts.text: Rome Statute Article 8: environmental damage a war crime only if intentional, widespread, long-term and severe

facts.text: Countries with ecocide laws: Vietnam, Russia, Ukraine, France, Belgium, Chile
